subject: PrivOffer: AWS marketplace — rev-share carveout & term exceptions
messages:
From: Leah Park <leah.park@amazon.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Daniel Eldridge <daniel@bluesummit.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Draft private offer for BlueSummit — rev-share proposal attached

Hi Priya,

Thanks for the sync yesterday. Attached is the initial AWS private-offer packet for BlueSummit. Per our conversation, Marketplace is proposing a modified rev-share split for placement: 18% to AWS, 7% to Redwood, which is outside your standard template (you normally run ~12% AWS / 10% Redwood for this tier). BlueSummit is asking for the reduced Redwood share to get better unit economics on their side — they’re committing to a 12-month consumption minimum and a $45k first-year commitment via the private offer.

Two immediate items to flag:
- Marketplace is requiring the offer term to align with AWS catalog terms (12 months) and a minimum annual commitment (MAC) clause.
- There is a carveout request on data residency language (BlueSummit wants EU-only logs retained for 90 days).

I attached the draft PDF and a short note from BlueSummit summarizing the ask. Can you confirm whether Redwood can accept the 7% share on this customer (gross margins attached), and whether the term/data carveout is acceptable? If not, we can route back to the AWS deal desk for adjustment.

Thanks,
Leah

Attachments: AWS_Private_Offer_Draft_2027-07-29.pdf
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah.park@amazon.com>, Daniel Eldridge <daniel@bluesummit.io>
Date: Thu, 29 Jul 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft private offer for BlueSummit — rev-share proposal attached

Vivek / Marissa,

Looping you in to escalate — AWS sent the private offer draft for BlueSummit. Key ask: Redwood net share falls to 7% vs our standard ~10% for deals of this size. BlueSummit is willing to sign a 12-month MAC of $45k and wants a short EU log-retention carveout (90 days).

Quick context: BlueSummit is a high-velocity retail partner — potential to expand across 3 more SKU lines in Q4. They are pushing hard for the placement economics to land the offer on AWS marketplace quickly (procurement timeline: needs signed by 8/5).

My read: 7% is a material hit but may be justified if we can secure the MAC and a clear expansion milestone clause. Finance will need margin numbers and legal needs to greenlight the data language. Can you advise:
- Vivek: are you willing to approve 7% for exec signoff if we attach an expansion milestone (e.g., $150k ARR by 12 months) and the MAC?
- Marissa: need quick margin calc and confirmation this is within acceptable revenue recognition / commission policy.

I included Leah and Daniel to keep transparency with AWS/BlueSummit. Attached a simple revshare model I built.

Thanks — Priya

Attachments: revshare_margin_model_2027-07-30.xlsx
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Jul 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft private offer for BlueSummit — rev-share proposal attached

Priya / Marissa —

Thanks for the flag. High-level: I’m open to approving a temporary reduction to 7% net to Redwood for this private offer provided we harden two items:
1) Binding expansion milestone: add a clause that if BlueSummit does not hit $150k ARR on Redwood-billed consumption within 12 months, rev-share reverts to our standard split (and any incremental marketplace credits are clawed back).
2) MAC enforcement and payment milestones (first 30 days deposit or signed PO to be included).

I’m not comfortable with changing our data residency default without legal signoff — Marissa / legal to weigh in on the EU log-retention 90-day carveout.

If finance confirms the unit economics (Marissa), I’ll sign off on the revised offer and ask legal to prep a clean amendment for the AWS private-offer flow. Priya — work with Leah to get language for the expansion milestone and payment schedule in the draft; also confirm timelines necessary to meet BlueSummit procurement (8/5).

Vivek
Chief Revenue Officer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 02 Aug 2027 09:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft private offer for BlueSummit — rev-share proposal attached

Priya / Vivek —

Reviewed the attached revshare model. Short summary:
- At the $45k MAC and a 7% net share, Redwood’s first-year gross contribution margin is ~18% after Marketplace fees and cloud infra pass-through (assumptions in the spreadsheet). That is below our target for new Marketplace-sourced logos (target ~24%).
- With the $150k expansion milestone guaranteed in writing and 30-day MAC payment, we can normalize commission plans (defer variable comp until milestone).

Requests before I sign off:
1) Update the model to include estimated support & account management staffing (we expect 0.1 FTE impact in Q1 post-onboard).
2) Add a clause for clawback of partner credits if milestone missed.

If those two items are captured, finance will accept the temporary rev-share concession for the signed private offer. Legal needs to confirm retention language before finalization.

Marissa
VP, Finance — Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Leah Park <leah.park@amazon.com>, Daniel Eldridge <daniel@bluesummit.io>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 01 Aug 2027 17:42:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Draft private offer for BlueSummit — rev-share proposal attached

Leah / Daniel —

Appreciate the quick turnaround. Per internal approval: Redwood can accept a one-time net share of 7% provided the following are included in the offer text and signed by BlueSummit:
- Binding expansion milestone: $150k ARR on Redwood consumption within 12 months or rev-share reverts to standard terms.
- MAC of $45k with 30-day payment milestone (PO or deposit).
- Clawback clause for partner credits if milestone is missed.
- Legal to confirm: EU log-retention carveout limited to non-production logs only, not modifying core data processing agreement.

Please update the private-offer draft to reflect the above and circulate for final signatures. I’ll loop legal to expedite the EU retention check; Marissa will publish an updated margin worksheet for signoff. We need a fully executed private offer by 8/5 to meet BlueSummit procurement timelines.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: revshare_margin_model_2027-07-30.xlsx
